KISWAHILI — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Use insults to “practise” Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maamkuzi na Maagano.
